lines.en: label mayachristmalloween1:
scene mayalovehotel1
There are several things in life I have accepted that I will never understand.
lines.zh: 人生中有好几件事，我已经接受自己永远不会懂了。

lines.en: And it doesn’t help that the first of those is something that can never be explained.
lines.zh: 而其中第一件恰恰是某种永远无法被解释的东西，这让情况更糟。

lines.en: It’d be far too convenient for someone to come along and tell me why we’re here. What any of this is. How the only mystery bigger than the goal I’m meant to have is where I’ll wake up in the morning.
lines.zh: 要是有人站出来告诉我我们为什么在这儿、这一切到底是什么、以及为什么唯一比我该达成的目标更大的谜团是「明早我会在哪儿醒来」，那未免太省事了。

lines.en: But someone did once. And beside me now is a girl who wears her skin. A hermit crab who found a pretty shell and crawled inside, not realizing that shell belonged to me.
lines.zh: 但曾经确实有人这么做过。而此刻在我身边的，是一个穿着她皮囊的女孩。一只寄居蟹找到一枚漂亮的壳爬了进去，却没意识到那枚壳是我的。

lines.en: Is it wrong to be possessive of something if that something was given to you? Is free will the dirt that muddies that question up?
lines.zh: 如果那样东西是被给你的，那么对它抱有占有欲是错的吗？是自由意志这摊泥把这个问题搅浑了吗？

lines.en: Because if it’s an issue of her wanting to leave one day, I don’t think that’d be an issue at all. And all it takes to find proof of that is one glance at how long she stayed.
lines.zh: 因为如果问题在于她有一天想离开，我觉得那根本不是问题。而要找到证明，只需看一眼她留了多久。

lines.en: And yes, this {i}can{/i} be seen as a prison — or something one can {i}not{/i} leave even if they want to. But there was a level of silent complacency I think we don’t think of often enough.
lines.zh: 是的，这{i}可以{/i}被看作一座监狱——或者一个你想走也走{i}不{/i}掉的地方。但我们似乎很少去想，这里面有某种沉默的安于现状。

lines.en: That same silence fills this room now, and it’s one more thing I don’t understand.
lines.zh: 此刻填满这房间的正是同一种沉默，而这又是一件我不懂的事。

lines.en: When I look into her eyes, I don’t understand what’s there either. Or what I’m meant to do despite having done this countless times before.
lines.zh: 当我望进她的眼睛，我也不懂那里面是什么。或者尽管已经做过无数次，我到底该做什么。

lines.en: So we sit and we wait for something to happen, unsure of where we’ll wake up in the morning, but hoping it’s beside one another because that’s something familiar.
lines.zh: 于是我们坐着，等某件事发生，不确定明早会在哪儿醒来，但愿是在彼此身边——因为那是某种熟悉的东西。

lines.en: She breathes a sigh of relief. Or stress. Or exhaustion. And nudges my leg with hers like she’s poking a corpse with a stick to check for signs of life.
lines.zh: 她叹了口气。是释然。是压力。还是疲惫。然后她用她的腿碰了碰我的腿，像拿棍子戳一具尸体，看还有没有活气。

lines.en: And I’m here.
lines.zh: 而我在这儿。

lines.en: I nudge her back to prove that — buying time to find the words to the questions I must ask before consuming her.
lines.zh: 我回碰她一下，证明我在——同时争取时间，去找那些我必须在占有她之前问出口的问题的词。

lines.en: Is a room like this somewhere I can find them, though? And what dust or muck will cover them if pulled from beneath the bed?
lines.zh: 可是在这样的房间里，我找得到它们吗？如果从床底下把它们拽出来，又会盖着怎样的灰尘和污垢？

lines.en: Could I cover her in them and still be awarded the same teasing smile she taunts me with whenever her body temperature rises?
lines.zh: 我能不能把它们盖在她身上，还照样换来她体温上升时用来逗我的那个戏谑的笑？

lines.en: Or would knowing there is more to this than love bring it right back down?
lines.zh: 还是说，一旦知道这背后不只有爱，那个笑就会立刻塌下去？

lines.en: People — one more mystery I must accept. One more that can never be explained, no matter what scholars or con-men may tell you.
lines.zh: 人——又一个我必须接受的谜。又一个无论学者还是骗子怎么跟你说，都无法解释的谜。

lines.en: For we are beings who do strange, inexplicable things. Make wishes before understanding what it is that we really want.
lines.zh: 因为我们是会做奇怪、无法解释之事的存在。在真正搞清楚自己想要什么之前，就先许了愿。

lines.en: But {i}wanting.{/i}
{i}That{/i} I understand.
lines.zh: {i}那个{/i}我懂。

lines.en: That incessant desire to pull something out of thin air. Or from one reality into the next just to fill some sort of void created by the unfortunate truth that the world wasn’t built for you.
lines.zh: 那种不停想把什么东西凭空拽出来的欲望。或者从一个现实拽进下一个现实，只为填补某个空洞——那空洞来自「这个世界不是为你造的」这个不幸的事实。

lines.en: But what if it was?
lines.zh: 可如果它是为你造的呢？

lines.en: What would it look like?
lines.zh: 那会是什么样子？

lines.en: Because when Maya thinks of me, I hope there is no dim light.
lines.zh: 因为当 Maya 想到我时，我希望那里没有昏暗的灯光。

lines.en: Nor vending machines packed with contraceptives. Dust in places hard to reach.
lines.zh: 也没有塞满避孕药的自动售货机。没有够不到的地方积着的灰。

lines.en: Sheets that have withstood the bodies of many other confused people, tangled up in one another like a knot begging to be pulled even tighter so they won’t have to worry about coming apart anymore.
lines.zh: 没有承受过许多其他迷惘之人身体的床单——他们缠在一起，像一个乞求被拉得更紧的结，好让自己再也不用担心散开。

lines.en: But they will.
lines.zh: 可它们会散。

lines.en: They always will.
lines.zh: 它们永远会散。

lines.en: And who would wish for a world like that?
lines.zh: 而谁会许愿要那样一个世界？

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel2

lines.en: : Well, perhaps those methods are being doubted at all because you keep expelling precious energy on girls like Nodoka when I am far more reusable than her.

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel3

lines.en: : Now, why would I thank her for draining you of some of the unfortunately finite amount of semen you can produce in one day? She is a thief as far as I’m concerned. A cum-bandit, if you will.

lines.en: : And it sure as hell doesn’t help that I still can’t help but feel like a stand-in for who you really want sometimes. Even {i}when{/i} you say you love me.

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel6

lines.en: : See, the difference {i}there{/i} is you have plenty of people saying those things to you.

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel7

lines.en: : I do. But it’s {i}because{/i} I get what you’re saying that I think we need to talk.

lines.zh: : Maya……这次重置有什么不一样。我有了以前没有的念头。关于你的念头。如果我说我对此毫不怀疑，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : I think your whole connection to this is bigger than the {i}old{/i} you made it out to be. That it isn’t just “bad luck.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得你跟这件事的关联，比{i}过去的{/i}你表现出来的更大。它不只是「运气不好」。

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel9
: {i}Hah...{/i}what is it then? Am I just {i}dreaming?{/i} Am I going to wake up one day and not have {i}anything{/i} anymore? What do you mean this might be “bigger?”
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……那是什么？我只是在{i}做梦{/i}吗？有一天我会醒来，然后{i}什么都没有{/i}了吗？你说这可能「更大」是什么意思？

lines.en: : Bigger than {i}what?{/i} We’re caught in a fucking time-loop thing. Is that not already big?

lines.zh: : 如果真是你以某种方式造成了这个……那么也只有由你{i}来{/i}结束它才说得通。对吧？

lines.zh: : 如果你控制不了我呢？万一那就是出问题的地方？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t wish for an infinite school life either. Literally {i}none{/i} of this is what I want. So the idea of it being something {i}I{/i} did, just...
lines.zh: : 我也不会许愿要一个无限的高中生活。这里{i}没有一样{/i}是我想要的。所以「这是{i}我{/i}干的」这个想法，只是……

lines.en: : No. There’s no way that’s true.

lines.en: : But you still doubt me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你还是在怀疑我，对吧？

lines.en: : Maya-

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel11

lines.en: : Like...I know you don’t fully trust me. But to trust some random thought that both you and Ayane had that you can’t even remember the {i}origin{/i} of over me? That hurts...
lines.zh: : 就……我知道你并不完全信任我。可你宁愿相信某个你和 Ayane 都有、却连{i}源头{/i}都记不起来的念头，也不信我？这很伤人……

lines.en: : I worked so hard to keep {i}us{/i} a secret, whether you have any memory of that or not. This isn’t something I’d lie about, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我那么努力地保守{i}我们{/i}的秘密，不管你还记不记得。这不是我会撒谎的事，老师。

lines.en: : And I’m not {i}asking{/i} for your trust because I think that would be a fucked up thing to do. The fact that there’s just none {i}there,{/i} though? Why?
lines.zh: : 我也不是在{i}要求{/i}你信任我，因为我觉得那样做太操蛋了。可事实是——{i}你那儿{/i}一点信任都没有。为什么？

lines.en: : I’m not saying you’re a liar, Maya. Just...maybe you don’t know the truth? Again, I’m not {i}blaming{/i} you for anything.
lines.zh: : 我不是说你是骗子，Maya。只是……也许你并不知道真相？再说一次，我不是在{i}怪{/i}你什么。

lines.en: scene mayalovehotel12
: Okay, but {i}I{/i} am! Because if {i}I{/i} wished for a world causing {i}both{/i} of us this much fucking misery, I’d be even {i}more{/i} miserable!
